related.title: Serve Stale DNS：服務韌性與資料年齡
related.titleEn: Serve Stale DNS: resilience versus data age
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受明確scope隔離並記錄隱私代價；不得為提高命中率跨不相容scope混用回應。 交接時須能核對：交付 ecs-cache.csv、變體數圖及無ECS對照。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require explicit scope separation and privacy accounting; do not mix incompatible scopes for hit rate. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ecs-cache.csv, variant-count plots and a no-ECS control.
related.difference: 記錄原到期、stale截止、刷新嘗試與回覆來源，不能只保存新的小TTL。
related.differenceEn: Record original expiry, stale deadline, refresh attempts and response provenance, not only a new short TTL.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
ECS會依客戶子網及scope切分快取；更細的前綴可增加快取變體並暴露更多位置資訊。
教學基準：100*2**(24-16) = 25600 entries；對照：100*2**(20-16) = 1600 entries。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Serve-stale允許特定失敗情境暫用過期資料；返回TTL與原始資料年齡需分開理解。
教學基準：300+600-700 = 200 s；對照：300+600-950 = -50 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
ECS partitions caches using client subnet and scope; finer prefixes can increase variants and reveal more location information.
Teaching baseline: 100*2**(24-16) = 25600 entries; comparison: 100*2**(20-16) = 1600 entries. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Serve-stale can temporarily use expired data in defined failure cases; response TTL and original data age differ.
Teaching baseline: 300+600-700 = 200 s; comparison: 300+600-950 = -50 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MPTCP：跨子流資料序號與重複交付
related.titleEn: MPTCP: cross-subflow data sequence and duplicate delivery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受明確scope隔離並記錄隱私代價；不得為提高命中率跨不相容scope混用回應。 交接時須能核對：交付 ecs-cache.csv、變體數圖及無ECS對照。

Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ecs-cache.csv, variant-count plots and a no-ECS control.
related.difference: 建立subflow seq到DSN映射與半開區間，按DSN聯集計算應用唯一資料量。
related.differenceEn: Map subflow sequence to DSN intervals and count unique application bytes by DSN union.
